description: This file defines the GatewayServiceResolver class, which uses NetService to resolve Bonjour services, providing host and port details without relying on TXT records for routing.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves network services via Bonjour (ZeroConf) and delivers connection details through a callback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with service name, type, domain, and a completion callback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the resolution process with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate method called upon successful resolution, retrieves and processes host and port information.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate method called upon resolution failure.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the resolution process, stopping the service and invoking the callback with the result.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static method to normalize the host string.
